claims.claim: Julius Africanus (c. 160–c. 240); Chronographiai first Christian universal chronology; wrote from Emmaus.
The Cesti were a wide-ranging miscellany (military science, farming, medicine, marvels); survives in fragments.
SCOPE: this volume gathers translated fragments from books 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 9, 13.
